resources.string: A few permissions let Meadow keep your promises for you. Your flower blooms as you go.
Lets Meadow measure how long each app is open. Required.

An accessibility service that notices which app is on screen and gently closes it when its time is up. It never reads what you type, and nothing on your screen leaves your phone. Required.\n\nIf the switch is greyed out, open Meadow\'s App info, tap ⋮ and choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
Reminders before time runs out, answers from your Bumblebees, and messages.
A backup, so the resting screen still appears if the garden keeper is ever paused.
Makes uninstalling Meadow a deliberate step. If it\'s ever turned off, your Bumblebees are told.
Keeps Meadow from being removed on a whim. Your Bumblebees are told if this is turned off.
Keeps the battery saver from putting the garden keeper to sleep.
Usage access and the garden keeper are needed
This build of Meadow isn\'t connected to a backend yet. Add your Firebase project\'s google-services.json to the app folder, deploy the backend, then rebuild. The README walks through each step.
